questions.q: Which country's COSMO-SkyMed satellite (CSG-FM3) was the world's first orbital launch of 2026, carried by a SpaceX Falcon 9?
questions.explain: SpaceX kicked off 2026 on January 2 by launching Italy’s CSG-FM3 radar satellite from Vandenberg. Its synthetic-aperture radar can capture sharp images through clouds and even in complete darkness.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) approved a ₹4,100-crore loan in January 2026 for the riverfront development of which river?
questions.explain: This is a big step for Hyderabad. The loan will help rejuvenate the Musi river in Telangana — cleaning it up, restoring heritage sites along its banks and turning the riverfront into a vibrant socio-economic corridor.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: World Braille Day is observed every year on 4 January to mark the birth anniversary of which inventor?
questions.explain: Louis Braille, born on this day in 1809, created the tactile reading-and-writing system that bears his name. World Braille Day celebrates how his invention opened up literacy and independence for visually impaired people everywhere.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Indian Army declared 2026 as its 'Year of ____', focusing on real-time connectivity and treating data as a key operational asset.
questions.explain: Building on 2024–25’s ‘Year of Technology Absorption’, the Army (under Gen Upendra Dwivedi) is now operationalising those tools. ‘Networking & Data Centricity’ means sensors and units share data instantly so the best-placed weapon can respond in real time.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which company became the first Indian company to cross ₹20 lakh crore in market capitalisation?
questions.explain: It's a massive milestone! Reliance Industries became the first Indian firm to touch ₹20 lakh crore (around US$240 billion) in market value, powered by its energy, retail and digital (Jio) businesses.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: In January 2026, External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar launched the 'IITM Global Research Foundation', an international initiative of which institution?
questions.explain: This is a bold move by IIT Madras to become the world’s first multinational university. Through campuses and MoUs in the US, Germany, Dubai, Malaysia and more, it aims to take its research and innovation strengths onto the global stage.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which nation currently holds the presidency of the G20 for the year 2026?
questions.explain: The United States took over the G20 presidency from South Africa on 1 December 2025 and will host the leaders’ summit in Miami in December 2026, with a focus on economic growth, energy and new technologies.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Ministry of Electronics & IT approved 22 proposals worth about ₹41,863 crore in early January 2026 under which scheme?
questions.explain: This push is all about making India self-reliant in electronics. By backing the manufacture of components — the building blocks inside every gadget — the government wants to cut import dependence and deepen the country’s electronics supply chain.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: The Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in the English language was awarded to which author for the novel 'Crimson Spring'?
questions.explain: Veteran diplomat-turned-author Navtej Sarna won the 2025 Sahitya Akademi Award for English for his novel ‘Crimson Spring’, set against the backdrop of the Jallianwala Bagh tragedy — a well-deserved nod to a powerful piece of historical fiction.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Which state has recently banned single-use plastic in all its major pilgrimage sites?
questions.explain: It was long overdue for places like Haridwar and Rishikesh. The local government is really pushing for 'Zero Waste' pilgrimages, and it’s heartening to see such a strong stand on environmental cleanliness.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.q: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda released the 10th edition of which official book of drug standards in early January 2026?
questions.explain: The Indian Pharmacopoeia is the official rulebook for medicine quality in India. Its 10th edition adds 121 new monographs (taking the total to 3,340) and fresh standards for blood components used in transfusion medicine.
